text:
hana: Postmortem for 2026-03-20 posted. We need to turn remediation into concrete tests and owners: regression, prompt expansion, load/soak, and a focused chaos drill. Short replies with owner + ETA pls.
derek: I can own the regression harness for the prefix/KV-cache race. Plan: pytest module + a lightweight staging integration that runs in CI. ETA: 3 business days.
sam: I'll take the load/soak job. Propose k6 with an option for distributed runners and a scheduled GH Action. Target: simulate 2k steady RPS and a 30s 10k burst. ETA: 5 days.
yara: I'll own prompt-set expansion and micro-evals. Focus on token-boundary cases and cache-miss long-tail examples (~50 inputs). Will add pass thresholds. ETA: 7 days.
infra-bot: PM-4567 linked by @hana: https://pm.redwood/company/PM-4567
hana: Chaos drill owner? We want a focused experiment that repros KV eviction under scale-to-zero and verifies fallback routing and model-variant swap safety.
derek: I can add a micro-eval to the regression that compares outputs pre/post fallback to catch silent quality regressions.
sam: Load plan sketch (will refine in PR):
```
name: incident-burst
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 2'
jobs:
  k6-burst:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/run_k6.sh --script k6/burst_10k_short.js --duration 60s
```
sam: Dashboard will track 95p latency, error-rate, and KV-eviction counters. Will wire alerts to #incidents.
yara: Prompt sets will live in github.com/redwood-inference/evals/prompt-sets/pm-4567-cache-edge and include example outputs + thresholds.
hana: Chaos drill proposal: tabletop Thu, staging run next Tue 10am PT. Steps: scale down a replica, run burst load, kill one pod, verify fallback <30s, verify micro-eval pass. Owner: sam + derek for eval check.
derek: I'll open GH issue and a draft PR for the regression today and tag owners + labels (incident-regression, priority-high).
sam: I'll add the GH Action + dashboard PR and link it here when ready.
yara: I'll push prompt-set PR with small eval harness and expected-pass metrics.
hana: Recap owners & deadlines: regression: derek by +3d; load/soak: sam by +5d; prompts: yara by +7d; chaos tabletop/run: sam by next Tue. Please drop PR links in this thread when created. Weekly follow-up Friday 9am PT to validate staging canary. If blocked, escalate here. :thumbsup:
